name: HubSpot CRM
description_en:
HubSpot CRM is the customer-record foundation of HubSpot's wider platform. Contacts, companies and deals represent people, organizations and sales work; properties describe them and associations connect them. Tasks and recorded interactions give teams context for the next action. The free tools provide an entry point, while paid Smart CRM and product hubs add capabilities under their own subscription conditions.

The useful selection question is which customer process you need to own now and which paid modules it will depend on later. A small sales team can begin with contact history and a deal pipeline, but marketing contact billing, advanced workflows and particular integrations are separate decisions. This profile focuses on data setup, a representative sales handoff and the documented cost/automation boundaries. It does not report a HubSpot account trial, implementation benchmark or verified customer return.
description_zh:
HubSpot CRM 是 HubSpot 整个平台的客户记录基础。联系人、公司和交易分别表示个人、组织及销售工作；属性描述记录，关联连接记录，任务和已保存互动为下一动作提供背景。免费工具是入门方式，付费 Smart CRM 及各产品 Hub 则按各自订阅条件扩展能力。

选型时应明确当前需要负责哪条客户流程，以及未来依赖哪些付费模块。小型销售团队可先使用联系人历史和交易管线，但营销联系人数计费、进阶工作流及具体集成是另外的决策。本文重点说明数据准备、代表性销售交接及文档中的费用／自动化边界，没有实际试用、实施基准或已验证客户收益。

core_features.explanation_en: Keep contact details, sales activities, communication history and opportunities in the CRM.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在 CRM 中保存联系人信息、销售活动、沟通历史及机会。

core_features.explanation_en: Bring contact-only spreadsheets through a quick import, mapping each column to a property.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过快速导入接收仅含联系人的表格，把各列映射到属性。

core_features.explanation_en: Use advanced imports for multiple objects and their relationships; identifiers determine update matching.
core_features.explanation_zh: 用高级导入处理多个对象和关系；标识符决定更新时的匹配。

core_features.name_zh: 依订阅开放的工作流构建器
core_features.explanation_en: Define enrollment criteria and actions in the full builder when the account and user have the required access.
core_features.explanation_zh: 账户及用户满足权限时，在完整构建器中定义进入条件和动作。

en: Associate two buying contacts with one company and a scoped sales deal.
Import a small customer file and review created, updated and error counts.
zh: 将两名采购联系人关联到一家公司及一项明确交易。
导入小批客户文件，核对新建、更新和错误数量。
use_cases.basis: Editorial examples, not executed imports or customer deployments.

Service access.en: Browser-based managed CRM with mobile apps advertised by HubSpot; no local server installation required for ordinary use.
Service access.zh: HubSpot 描述通过浏览器访问托管 CRM，并提供移动应用；普通使用无需安装本地服务器。

steps.en: Define contact/company/deal properties and an association model before importing.
steps.zh: 导入前定义联系人／公司／交易属性及关联模型。

steps.en: Use a small sample and the appropriate quick or advanced import; inspect mapping and unique identifiers.
steps.zh: 使用小批样例选择快速或高级导入，检查映射及唯一标识符。

steps.en: Review updated/new records, associations and errors, then verify the retained subscription before publishing any automated outreach.
steps.zh: 核对更新／新建记录、关联和错误，再按长期保留订阅确认自动外联权限后发布。

items.en: Quick import is contact-only; company/deal relationships need the advanced import path.
items.zh: 快速导入仅处理联系人；公司／交易关系需要高级导入路径。

items.en: Deleting an import does not reverse values changed on existing records.
items.zh: 删除导入记录不会恢复既有记录被修改的值。

items.en: Full workflows and individual actions depend on subscription, seat/credit conditions and user permissions; Free or Starter limits differ.
items.zh: 完整工作流及具体动作受订阅、席位／积分条件及用户权限限制；Free 或 Starter 的限制不同。

pricing.billing_basis: Free tools plus selected paid hubs/seat plans, relevant marketing-contact tiers and usage/credit conditions.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Free page shows $0/month up to two users. Starter promotional and reference seat amounts appear with offer/billing selectors; final paid price not normalized.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 免费页列出每月0美元、最多2用户。Starter 同时显示促销及参考席位金额与优惠／周期选择，未统一为最终付费价。

faq.question_en: Is the free CRM a short trial?
faq.question_zh: 免费 CRM 是否只是短期试用？
faq.answer_en: The canonical product page describes no expiry, with up to two users and 1,000 contacts. This does not include every paid product feature.
faq.answer_zh: 产品原页说明无到期日，最多2用户及1,000联系人；不表示包含每项付费产品功能。

faq.question_en: Can a contact record be created while one imported field fails?
faq.question_zh: 导入时某字段失败，联系人仍可能已创建吗？
faq.answer_en: Yes. The error guide distinguishes errors that prevent a row from importing from errors affecting only individual property values.
faq.answer_zh: 可能。错误指南区分阻止整行导入的错误，以及仅影响个别属性值的错误。

official_check.scope: Public vendor documentation reviewed; no account execution, purchase, owner identity, independent review or publication approval.

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent reliability, usability or customer-outcome verification.
English and Chinese are paired drafts. Chinese text does not establish Chinese UI support.
All alternative relationships remain unreviewed. Public-web retrieval may use cached content; prices are dated observations.

sections.title_en: A buying group is more than one email address
sections.title_zh: 采购关系不只是一个邮箱
sections.en:
For a hypothetical software supplier, one company may have a procurement contact and a technical evaluator, both associated with one sales deal. The people need distinct contact details; the company carries organizational information; the deal carries its own amount, stage and next action. This is an editorial data-model example based on the supported object/association imports.

Decide what uniquely identifies each record before migration. Name similarity is not a reliable update rule. A unique identifier is required to match imported data with an existing record, and an empty identifier can produce new records. Check the resulting associations as well as the row count. No such import was executed here.
sections.zh:
以假设的软件供应商为例，一家公司可能有采购联系人和技术评估人，两者关联到同一笔交易。个人需要独立联系方式，公司保存组织信息，交易则有自己的金额、阶段及下一动作。这是依据对象／关联导入能力设计的编辑示例。

迁移前应确定各记录的唯一标识。名字相似不是可靠更新规则。导入数据匹配现有记录需要唯一标识，标识为空可能新增记录。应同时检查最终关联和行数。本文未执行这种导入。

sections.title_en: Quick import and advanced import solve different jobs
sections.title_zh: 快速与高级导入解决不同任务
sections.en:
Quick contact import accepts a contact-only spreadsheet with headers, one contact per row and columns mapped to properties. It can create or update contacts without configuring associations or advanced marketing-contact choices. It requires import permission.

Use the advanced route when bringing companies, deals, activities or relationships together. Existing emails, meetings, notes and tasks cannot be updated by import. Importing association labels requires higher subscriptions than simply creating basic relationships. Start with a disposable sample containing a known existing contact, a new contact and one intended company relationship; examine which records change before scaling the file.
sections.zh:
联系人快速导入接收带表头、每行一个联系人、各列映射到属性的纯联系人表格，可以新建或更新联系人，不配置关联或进阶营销联系人选项，并需要导入权限。

公司、交易、活动或关系一起迁入时应使用高级路径。已有邮件、会议、备注及任务不能通过导入更新。导入关联标签与仅创建基础关系的订阅要求也不同。建议先用含已知联系人、新联系人及预期公司关系的可丢弃样例，核对实际变化后再扩大文件。

sections.title_en: A completed import can contain partial failures
sections.title_zh: 完成的导入仍可能部分失败
sections.en:
The import dashboard separates new records, updated records, new associations and errors. The error guide distinguishes a rejected row from a property value that was not imported while the rest of that row was accepted. Do not infer that every field is valid from a completed status.

Inspect the error details and download the error file where useful. For a correction, preserve the intended identifiers and recheck the destination values. Deleting records created by an import does not undo updates to records that existed before it. A before/after sample and retained original file are therefore sensible evaluation safeguards, not evidence of automatic rollback.
sections.zh:
导入看板分别显示新建记录、更新记录、新关联和错误。错误指南区分整行被拒，以及某属性值未导入但该行其他部分已接收。不能由完成状态推断每个字段都有效。

应检查错误详情，必要时下载错误文件。修正时保留预期标识符，并重新核对目标值。删除由导入新增的记录，不会撤回之前已存在记录的更新。因此建议保留原文件及前后样例；这不表示存在自动回滚。

sections.title_en: Full workflows have their own entitlements
sections.title_zh: 完整工作流有独立权益要求
sections.en:
The workflow guide lists eligible Professional/Enterprise subscriptions and distinguishes edit from publish permission. It supports enrollment triggers and configured actions, including acting on associated records. A locked action can require an upgrade even when a workflow is otherwise available. The pricing page separately describes narrower Free/Starter automations, so an automation label alone does not establish full-builder access.

When publishing, choose whether records already meeting the criteria should enroll or only future qualifying records. Re-enrollment is a separate setting and does not put a currently active record into the same workflow again. Check the intended recipients before activating a workflow that sends customer messages. No workflow was activated for this research.
sections.zh:
工作流指南列出符合条件的 Professional／Enterprise 订阅，并区分编辑和发布权限。它支持进入触发器及配置动作，也可操作关联记录。即使工作流本身可用，锁定动作仍可能要求升级。定价页另有范围较窄的 Free／Starter 自动化，因此仅有“自动化”标签不能证明能访问完整构建器。

发布时需选择让已符合条件的记录进入，还是仅处理未来符合条件的记录。再次进入是独立设置，不会让仍在执行的记录同时重复进入相同工作流。启用客户发信流程前，应检查实际接收人。本文没有启用任何工作流。

sections.title_en: Free capacity and promotional paid prices
sections.title_zh: 免费容量与促销付费价格
sections.en:
The current product page describes ongoing free CRM use with up to two users and 1,000 contacts. The free pricing page lists $0/month and no card requirement. These are capacity and feature conditions, not an unlimited entitlement to the entire HubSpot suite.

The retrieved USD pricing page also shows Starter from $7/month/seat alongside a $20 reference amount, with limited-time/new-customer offer wording and billing selectors. The text does not establish one universally payable subscription. Record the selected hub/bundle, seats, commitment, marketing capacity and credits when pricing a real account. A low starting seat figure is not a total implementation or messaging budget.
sections.zh:
当前产品页说明 CRM 可持续免费使用，最多2用户、1,000联系人。免费定价页列出每月0美元且无需银行卡。这些仍有容量和功能条件，不代表获得整个 HubSpot 产品套件的不限量权益。

所读美元定价页还同时显示 Starter 起价每席位每月7美元及20美元参考金额，附有限时／新客户优惠文字和周期选择。文本不能确立人人适用的实付订阅。真实报价需记录所选 Hub／组合、席位、承诺期限、营销容量及积分。较低席位起价不是实施或消息发送总预算。

sections.title_en: A CRM contact and a billable marketing contact differ
sections.title_zh: CRM 联系人与计费营销联系人不同
sections.en:
For eligible Marketing Hub subscriptions with marketing contacts, the documentation distinguishes billable marketing contacts from non-marketing contacts. Exceeding the tier can automatically move the account to a higher tier; later reducing the count does not undo that higher tier before renewal.

Changing marketing contacts to non-marketing takes effect on the account's update date, not necessarily when the operator clicks. Before importing or enabling a form/workflow that sets marketing status, confirm the current tier, update date and maximum-marketing-contact setting. This is a paid Marketing Hub condition, not a claim that every contact in every free CRM is separately billed. No billing change or savings outcome was tested.
sections.zh:
对于包含营销联系人的适用 Marketing Hub 订阅，文档区分计费营销联系人和非营销联系人。超过档位可能自动升到更高档位；之后人数减少，也不会在续订前撤回该高档位。

营销联系人改为非营销联系人，按账户更新日生效，不一定在操作时立即生效。导入或启用会设置营销状态的表单／工作流前，应核对当前档位、更新日及营销联系人上限设置。这是付费 Marketing Hub 条件，不代表每个免费 CRM 的所有联系人都单独收费。本文未测试计费变化或节省成效。

sections.title_en: Keep the CRM foundation separate from the whole platform
sections.title_zh: 区分 CRM 基础与整个平台
sections.en:
The canonical page places Smart CRM beneath the broader marketing, sales, service and other HubSpot tools. Shared customer data makes cross-team processes possible, but the user's permissions and purchased products still determine available actions. Evaluate one end-to-end path: record creation, owner assignment, the next activity and the resulting customer context.

This model merits investigation when multiple customer-facing teams need connected records and are prepared to govern fields, access and paid modules. A narrow address book or a need for unrestricted local execution has different requirements. Browser access and mobile apps are documented; a self-hosted deployment or open-source license was not established here. No connector was run, and exact API limits, export completeness, data-location choices, regional payment eligibility and UI languages remain unconfirmed.
sections.zh:
产品原页将 Smart CRM 放在更广的营销、销售、服务等 HubSpot 工具之下。共享客户数据让跨团队流程成为可能，但实际动作仍由用户权限及已购买产品决定。建议验证一条完整路径：创建记录、分配负责人、下一项活动和最终客户背景。

多个面向客户的团队需要关联记录，且愿意管理字段、访问及付费模块时，这种模型值得考察。仅需简单通讯录或不受限本地执行，则属于不同需求。文档说明浏览器及移动应用访问，但本文未确立自行托管部署或开源许可。未运行连接器；准确 API 限制、完整导出、数据位置选项、地区支付资格及界面语言仍未确认。

seo.title_en: HubSpot CRM: Records, Import Errors, Free Limits and Paid Workflows
seo.title_zh: HubSpot CRM：记录、导入错误、免费限制与付费工作流
seo.description_en: Understand HubSpot CRM object associations, quick/advanced imports, partial failures, workflow entitlements and marketing-contact billing conditions.
seo.description_zh: 了解 HubSpot CRM 对象关联、快速／高级导入、部分失败、工作流权益及营销联系人数计费条件。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate HubSpot CRM data and sales workflow requirements without conflating free tools and all paid hubs.
secondary_questions: Can imported updates be undone by deletion?
When do marketing-contact changes affect billing?
seo.query_basis: Editorial question selection; no search-volume, ranking or AI-citation measurement.

research_gaps.en: Exact paid checkout configuration, API limits, connector behavior, export completeness, license/self-hosting options, UI languages, regional payment and data-location choices not established.
research_gaps.zh: 准确付费结账配置、API 限制、连接器行为、完整导出、许可／自行托管选项、界面语言、地区支付及数据位置选择尚未确认。

research_gaps.en: No account, import, workflow, marketing email, AI tool or billing operation was executed; documented capabilities are not independent test results.
research_gaps.zh: 未执行账户、导入、工作流、营销邮件、AI 工具或计费操作；文档能力不代表独立测试结果。
